compute_bbox_proj: compute the 2D bounding box of 3D vertices projected onto the image plane in xywh format
compute_optimal_translation: compute the optimal 3D translation to align a mesh to a target bounding box using least squares
PoseOptimizer_forward: compute the occlusion-aware silhouette loss including mask, chamfer, and offscreen penalty terms for pose optimization
find_optimal_pose: find the optimal 3D pose for a single object mesh given a target mask and bounding box via multi-start optimization
find_optimal_poses: optimize 3D poses for all detected object instances in an image using silhouette matching against instance masks
